audit.method: Recursive filename search in Downloads directories. Only provider-named candidates would have been eligible for metadata inspection and text-layer PDF extraction.

result.status: no provider-named downloaded billing files found
result.interpretation: This is a coverage result, not evidence of zero cost. Generic invoice files were intentionally excluded because their filenames do not identify an in-scope provider and could contain unrelated private correspondence or client billing.
limitations: The search covered the existing Linux Downloads directory and two mounted standard Windows user Downloads directories.
Evidence stored outside Downloads or under generic filenames was outside this narrowly authorized local search.
No OCR decision was needed because there were no candidate PDFs.

sanitization: No raw filenames, paths, invoice or customer identifiers, tax identifiers, personal addresses, account identifiers, attachment identifiers or tokens are included.

effective_period.basis: date of local evidence coverage check
